content.short: Business banking for SMEs with accounts, cards and admin tools.
content.description: Tide is a business financial platform serving small and medium enterprises, most prominently in the United Kingdom and India, with a mission to save business owners time on their finances. It offers business accounts with cards, invoicing, expense categorization, VAT and tax tools, integrations with accounting software, and access to credit and other financial services through partners. Rather than being a fully licensed bank in the traditional sense, Tide focuses on an admin-light, member-first experience that bundles banking with the back-office tools freelancers and SMEs need to run a company. With millions of members across its markets, Tide competes with banks and other challengers by combining an accessible business account with practical bookkeeping and admin features tailored to small businesses.
